theorems.name: Submission.indCompact_transEst_integral_indicator_shift_mul
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn N → ℝ) (h : Rn N), NullMeasurableSet F volume → Integrable ψ volume → ∫ y, (F.indicator (1 : Rn N → ℝ) (y + h) - F.indicator (1 : Rn N → ℝ) y) * ψ y = ∫ z in F, (ψ (z - h) - ψ z)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
